highlights.label: Performance
highlights.text: Halved time-to-interactive on startup by batching and removing network requests on the critical path.

highlights.label: Platform Stability
highlights.text: Added retry mechanisms at common failure points — resulting in a +2% improvement in app startup success rate.

highlights.label: Growth & Matchmaking
highlights.text: Improved game-join success rate by +4% by identifying failure cases, redesigning UX routes, and adding in-game feedback toasts to reduce user confusion during loading.

about.summary: Hi! I'm Eric. I was a software engineer on the App and Growth teams at Roblox — I joined when there were about 800 people and left when there were 2500. I'm looking for an opportunity to join a smaller team where I can more directly impact the product.
paragraphs: I loved being at Roblox. I got to learn from and work with the smartest people I've ever met. It was awesome to work on something that so many users loved.

I left because I wanted to join or start a startup. Unfortunately those plans were delayed when I crashed my car :<. I'm all recovered now! I've been traveling and enjoying some rest. I used the downtime to work on other projects I've wanted to tackle forever: AI agents to support vibecoders, IRL games, and some math projects.
I like working close to users, shipping fast, and feeling like my work has a real impact on people.
